Text: Ah... What a predictable outcome. A mere human, brash, reckless and  utterly lacking in grace as usual. Smashing through my ancient, irreplaceable  castle walls with... this.

Wizard extraordinaire, castle prisoner, and now your official guide to not dying in this madhouse.

Good news: I can help! Bad news: this place is crawling with traps and goons.
More good news! I've scattered some magical tips around the castle. Call it... wizard graffiti, if you will. Keep your eyes peeled! And don't worry, I'll check in from time to time.

Oh... and watch out for that landing.
Is this what my father's castle has been reduced too? Filthy peasants intruding and tracking mud across the marble?
Well, you clearly have no idea whose presence you've just barged into. Let me take some pity and educate you on the matter.
Buh-bye, peasant!
Even the rats in my father's dungeon have more refinement than you.Shall we see how you fair against them?
And yet, you march in here like some bold little hero, thinking you stand a chance? Ohhh, that is just hilarious!
